generate_k_shot_classification: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for a classification dataset using a random seed
generate_k_shot_text_to_text: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for a text-to-text dataset using a random seed
save_k_shot_data: save k-shot train dev and test data to JSONL files with optional prompt application
get_train_test_lines: extract train and validation lines from a HuggingFace dataset using the configured mapper
write_jsonl: write a list of lines to a JSONL file skipping any None entries
